title: New Jobs Filled by Singaporeans, PRs and Foreigners in Industries Covered by Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs)
what_it_is: New Jobs Filled by Singaporeans, PRs and Foreigners in Industries Covered by Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs)

sections.label: Employment change by residency
sections.summary: Between 2015 and 2018, total employment in these sectors excluding foreign domestic workers grew by 19,500, with SCs up 39,300, PRs up 8,600 and foreigners down 28,500.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2015 and 2018, total employment in these sectors, excluding foreign domestic workers, grew by 19,500.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This was made up of: (a) an increase in employment of Singapore Citizens (SCs) by 39,300; (b) increase in employment of Permanent Residents (PRs) by 8,600; and (c) a decrease in employment of foreigners by 28,500.

sections.label: Training participation and job placements
sections.summary: Between 2015 and 2018, resident labour force training participation rose from 35% to 48%, and from 2016 to September 2019 Adapt and Grow helped 93,000 locals into new jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2015 and 2018, the training participation rate of the resident labour force aged from 15 to 64 increased from 35% to 48%, which shows that more Singaporeans are upgrading and updating their skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2016 until September 2019, Workforce Singapore and the National Trades Union Congress' Employment and Employability Institute (e2i) have also helped 93,000 locals move into new jobs through the Adapt and Grow initiative.
